description: This Java source file defines the ConceptClassEditor class, which extends OpenmrsPropertyEditor to serialize and deserialize ConceptClass objects, supporting both numeric IDs and UUIDs for retrieval via the OpenMRS context's concept service.

classes.name: ConceptClassEditor
classes.description: A property editor for ConceptClass objects enabling conversion between string representations (IDs or UUIDs) and ConceptClass instances.

methods.name: getObjectById(Integer id)
methods.description: Retrieves a ConceptClass object from the database using its integer ID.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid(String uuid)
methods.description: Retrieves a ConceptClass object from the database using its UUID.
